scenes.name: HALF ANGLE
lines: A rotor about z is cosine of half the angle, minus sine of half the angle times the plane e one e two.
绕 z 轴的旋转器是 R_z(θ) = cos(θ/2) − sin(θ/2) e₁e₂：它只记半角。
Sandwich the arrow between the rotor and its reverse.
把箭头夹在旋转器与它的逆序之间：v ↦ R v R̃。
The shadow on the axis commutes with the plane, so it stays put.
轴上的影子与平面 e₁e₂ 可交换，原地不动。
The part in the plane anticommutes, and the two half angles close into the whole turn.
平面里的那一份与它反对易：左右两个半角合拢成整角 θ。

scenes.name: THREE TURNS
lines: Now chain three such turns: about z, then y, then z again.
现在串接三段：绕 z，再绕 y，再绕 z。
Take alpha zero point three seven, beta minus zero point eight one, gamma zero point five two.
The arrow turns by gamma first, then beta, then alpha: the rightmost rotor touches it first.
箭头先转 γ，再转 β，最后转 α：最右边的旋转器最先碰到它。

scenes.name: ONE ROTOR
lines: Multiply the three rotors, and one even element with four coefficients is left.
三枚旋转器相乘，只剩一枚有四个系数的偶元素。
A scalar of zero point eight three and three bivector parts; their squares still sum to one.
标量 0.830，加三份双矢量；四个系数的平方和仍是 1。
Sandwich the three basis vectors with it, and out come the columns of the ZYZ matrix.
用它夹住三根基向量，出来的正是 ZYZ 矩阵的三列。

scenes.name: ONE AXIS
lines: The literature says more: every unit rotor is a single turn about a single axis.
文献结果说得更多：每一枚单位旋转器都是绕一根轴的一次转动。
Here the axis comes from the bivector part, and the angle is twice the arc cosine of the scalar: sixty-seven point nine degrees.
这里转轴取自双矢量部分，转角是标量的反余弦的两倍：标量约为 0.829591626，2 arccos(0.829591626) ≈ 67.9°。
One turn lands exactly where the three turns did.
这一次转动，正好落在三段转动走到的那一点。

scenes.name: T AND H
lines: Up to a global phase, the T gate is one turn about z by forty-five degrees.
除去整体相位，T 门就是绕 z 轴转 45°：R_T = 0.924 − 0.383 e₁e₂。
The Hadamard gate is zero, ninety degrees, one eighty: a pure bivector.
阿达玛门是 (0, π/2, π)：一枚纯双矢量 R_H = −0.707 e₁e₂ − 0.707 e₂e₃。
It swaps e one and e three, and flips e two.
它交换 e₁ 与 e₃，并把 e₂ 翻成 −e₂。

scenes.name: ON THE SPHERE
lines: Every arrow on these paths names a pure state: rho is the Bloch matrix of one and v.
这些路径上的每一根箭头都对应一个纯态：ρ = blochMatrix(1, v)。
Lean checks that its trace is one, and that reading off its Bloch vector gives v back.
Lean 检验了：它的迹为 1，读出的布洛赫向量正是 v。
A Hermitian matrix of trace one that squares to itself has a Bloch vector of length exactly one.
迹为 1、自乘不变的厄米矩阵，布洛赫向量的长度恰为 1。
And a trace-one positive semidefinite matrix stays inside the unit ball.
迹为 1 的正半定矩阵则留在单位球内：‖bloch M‖ ≤ Re Tr M = 1。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Geometric Intuition of Quantum Computing, chapter twenty-six.
《量子计算的几何直觉》· 第二十六章
